label: early-episode D1 after a rewarded S2 trial, while the policy leans moderately toward a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1. The previous trial (when it is in the window) is almost always a2 and reached S2 (prev_common==1; almost never S1). It is confined to the start of the episode: trials 3-29, peaking at 10-19, and essentially never after trial 30. It is concentrated in episodes that start with S2 good (93% of mass) and when the policy logit sits in a moderate a2-preference band (choice between -4.44 and -1.52; value 7.5-7.7). Within a run of consecutive rewarded a2 to S2 trials, the activation decays steadily from trial to trial (e.g. 0.56, 0.52, 0.47, 0.43, 0.38), so magnitude looks like it tracks how early in the episode / how settled the a2 preference is. It never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1s, or after S1 outcomes. All variables are observed (choice is the model's own logit at this step). A start_high==0 version scored about the same (dev F1 0.56). The observed predicate covers about 99% of activations on dev, but precision is about 45%: many matching early rewarded D1s stay below threshold, so the exact trigger (a narrow region of the slowly drifting hidden state) is not fully captured.
